external_final_test: All 15 CognitiveLoad_Wearables participants. Excluded from training, feature normalization, unsupervised pretraining, prompt selection and hyperparameter tuning. Inspect schema/units and alignment, not target distributions or outcomes before frozen selection.
development: Original UNIVERSE development participants; compatible newly accessible labeled sources after source-specific mapping. Existing SWELL as separate non-wrist benchmark. CLACIR/CogWear can contribute unlabeled pretraining; task classes remain auxiliary, never relabeled as questionnaire ratings.
excluded: future data in features or personal baseline
development_trials: manufacturer IBI when alignment and gap checks pass
pooled training only on compatible labels
coarse 3-level TLX evaluation with fixed thresholds 100/3 and 200/3; separate from original rating accuracy
scoring: Per-observation error then block mean then person mean. Participant-grouped development folds. External test scored once after all final choices frozen.

mvp_research_gate.meaning: Provisional engineering criterion, not clinical or workplace validation; cannot be passed by task-condition classification or provider confidence.

stop_rule: Complete feasible bounded experiments on accessible sources. Report outstanding source-access/evidence limits and all outcomes. Do not repeatedly tune on external test or lower the gate after seeing results.
